long_biography.plain_text:
Growing up in a home above SAATI's factory gave Alberto Novarese an early view of industrial life. After graduating from Bocconi, he spent a year at an American business that the group later acquired as its largest subsidiary. He took charge after his father's death and developed operations across Europe, Asia and the United States.

Before turning forty, Novarese appointed a chief executive from outside the family and recast his own role around strategy. He strengthened middle management, introduced formal systems and backed research-led diversification. In 2011 he also established the Carlo Novarese Foundation, carrying forward his father's education and social-support projects in Italy and Brazil.
